correctness.rationale: All nonzero exterior-join monomials are pairs of disjoint graph edges and hence valid 3-simplices. Degree four simplices cannot exist in a bipartite graph, so H3 is the top chain kernel. The field-uniform induction proves independence, using a new-vertex projection and an independently proved injectivity lemma for the unique-common-neighbor corner case. Published homotopy rank plus rank mod every prime makes the integer sublattice saturated. The geometric symmetry multiplies both square boundaries by identical orientation sign, which cancels in their product. The bundled independent finite checker reproduced signed chains, boundaries, rank and symmetry actions.
